changelog: [Never Segment]: Removed the over-broad prohibition against segmenting after a bare noun/fragment with no verb, particle, or connective attached — this rule was blocking legitimate low-risk candidates (e.g. after NP+particle stretches awaiting a later verb) and suppressing coverage. Narrowed the filler prohibition so it only blocks positions where literally nothing but filler words has been produced, not positions after filler-plus-some-content.

[Decision Procedure]: Added explicit instruction in Step 1 that candidacy scanning must include positions after any noun phrase, particle-marked argument, or connective ending even when the governing predicate, reporting verb, or postposed subject has not yet appeared — these are still valid low-confidence candidates to be ranked (not discarded) in Step 2, directly increasing the number of marked boundaries available to the budget-trimming step.
